title: Devotee's Mace

sources.title: Healing Incense Aura
markers: | summary = '''Healing Incense Aura''' is a class action only found as a special action on the [[Devotee's Mace]]. It allows the wielder to heal allies constantly for 10 turns.

summary: A +3 mace dealing 1d6 + 3 Bludgeoning and 1d8 Radiant. Its main-hand aura heals the wielder and nearby allies.

fields.Healing Incense Aura: Bonus Action once per Long Rest while equipped in the main hand. You and allies within 30 ft heal 1d4 HP at the start of your turns for 10 turns.
fields.Base value: 640 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
